verdict.rationale: Folk's pricing page lists "Pipeline management" as a product feature and a higher tier adds "Custom objects & Deals". The developer docs confirm Deals exist as configurable custom objects defined inside groups, so deal tracking in a pipeline is the product's own capability. Nothing in the pack describes the visual pipeline itself, user-defined stages, or drag-and-drop updates. missing for 10: evidence of a visual kanban/board view, documentation of customizable pipeline stages, drag-and-drop stage updates, independent or hands-on corroboration.
